messages:
Maya: quick kickoff  need a lean social plan for the release week. goals = webinar signups, benchmark narrative, and clear SDR routing for high-intent replies.
Jonah: propose cadence: day0 teaser, day2 benchmark thread, day4 webinar push, day6 follow-up + customer quotes. X for engineers, LinkedIn for PMs.
Priya: I can deliver 30s hero + 15s cut, plus a 3-card carousel. need copy + final CTAs by tomorrow noon. Figma will be used for review.
Sam: tracking/routing: all webinar CTAs must append utm_source and utm_campaign (e.g., ?utm_source=x_social&utm_campaign=may_spark) so webhook rules map to Webinar_SDR. Replies containing exact phrases "Interested demo" or "Book call" -> flag as high-intent. Signups tag = "webinar_signup" lead_score=50.
Maya: prefer graph hero for X (fast-read), product UI for LinkedIn. pin benchmark thread day2 and boost the winning X post to dev audience.
Jonah: A/B plan for thread: A = metrics-first (latency/cost bullets), B = dev quickstart (mini code snippet + checklist). measure CTR to signup and count of high-intent replies.
Priya: thumbnails question  include a short headline on the graph but keep axis labels off. will add both frame variants to Figma.
Sam: running webhook test now. SocialBot: scheduled preview created  4 posts (X+LinkedIn), 2 clips, 1 carousel. Preview: https://redwood.social/preview/5410001112
Sam: webhook test -> 200 OK. Sample log: "routed -> Webinar_SDR (lead_score=50)". Will paste full logs to #eng-infra. Also added tweet_id -> intake mapping for SDR context.
Brand: one quick note  reduce headline font weight on mobile thumbnails; Priya, please update.
Maya: next steps: Jonah finalize copy by 11am tomorrow, Priya deliver assets by EOD, Sam confirm final webhook + test logs, I'll finalize boost targets and schedule. Final sign-off check-in tomorrow 9:30am PT. :rocket:
